# Fictional onboarding proposal: source notes

Original example written for this guide. No real company or measured result.

- N1 [current state]: Setup instructions are in a chat thread, a shared document,
  and a pinned message: three locations.
- N2 [reported observation]: The support lead says new teammates ask repeated
  setup questions. No count or baseline period has been supplied.
- N3 [proposal]: Try one shared onboarding checklist instead of changing every
  team process at once.
- N4 [proposal]: Run a two-week trial, subject to team approval.
- N5 [measurement proposal]: Use a question log during the trial and compare it
  with a baseline collected using the same definitions. Baseline is not yet available.
- N6 [unknown]: Trial owner, starting date, and review meeting date are not assigned.

Presentation audience: support team.
Requested decision: whether to approve the trial and assign its owner.
Format: six slides, five-minute discussion.
